newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly down in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly down in lower volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Tuesday closed slightly down in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 616.75 from 617.32 on Monday.
Trade volume was 2.57 million dinars against 2.91 million dinars. Like on Monday, the occasional market was the most active with contracts totalling 2.204 million dinars.
Banque de Tunisie was up 1.63 dinar to 79.47 dinars. UBCI up 0.5 dinar to 53.06 dinars.
STB bank was down 0.69 dinar to 22.2 dinars and BDET bank down 0.64 dinar to 20.76 dinars.
